idea-plugin.name: Tailwind Rainbow
idea-plugin.description:
Colorizes Tailwind CSS variant prefixes so long class lists stay readable.

Each variant — hover, focus, sm, dark, arbitrary values such as [&>*], and the ! important modifier — is painted in its own color, making the structure of a class list visible at a glance.

Works in HTML, JSX/TSX, Vue, Svelte, Astro, PHP, and in CSS @apply directives. Colors, themes, and the recognized attributes, helper functions, and file types are configurable under Settings | Editor | Tailwind Rainbow.
